select

t_money.is_delete = 0 and ${column} in
${id}

SELECT -1 * sum( CASE WHEN amount < 0 THEN amount END ) AS 'income', sum( CASE WHEN amount > 0 THEN amount END ) AS 'expenditure', -1 * sum( amount ) AS 'balance', ROUND(sum( CASE WHEN amount > 0 and recurring_transaction is null THEN amount END ) / #{day}, 2) AS'average' FROM t_money WHERE DATE > #{dateStartS} AND DATE < #{dateEndS}

SELECT
FROM t_money
and payment_time > STR_TO_DATE( #{dto.dateStartS}, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' )
and payment_time < STR_TO_DATE( #{dto.dateEndS}, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' )
ORDER BY payment_time DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(payment_time,'%Y-%m') AS month
,SUM(CASE WHEN category = #{category} THEN amount END) AS `${category}`
FROM t_money WHERE payment_time IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(payment_time,'%Y-%m') ORDER BY DATE_FORMAT(payment_time,'%Y-%m') DESC
